ranked.headline: Inferring transcriptional regulation and cell communication from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomes now support splicing-aware, kinetic, and cross-platform inference of regulatory and communication programs.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools standardise preprocessing and analysis across omics and imaging data
ranked.summary: Recent releases pair installable tools with preprocessing, file-format and no-code interfaces across omics and imaging modalities.

ranked.headline: Learned and physics-based models benchmarked against experimental protein stability data
ranked.summary: Mega-scale folding and large mass-spec aggregation datasets now allow direct benchmarking of computational protein predictions.

ranked.headline: Temporal and single-cell dynamics reveal aging trajectories across ovaries and menopause
ranked.summary: Large-scale temporal reconstruction and cell-level dynamical inference are converging on how aging trajectories unfold.

ranked.headline: Fusing sequence, structure, and language embeddings for molecular prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints combine protein language model embeddings with 3D structure, chemical featurizers, and text encoders to improve biological prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Graph and k-mer indexing drive new microbial genome analysis software
ranked.summary: Sequence-level tools now exploit pan-genome graphs, k-mer indexes, and pretrained language models to scale microbial and viral genomic analysis.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware generative models steer protein and ligand design toward target function
ranked.summary: Generative and predictive models are being steered with structural, energy, and synthesizability constraints across protein, antibody, and molecule design.

ranked.headline: Language-model agents are entering single-cell and spatial transcriptomics annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether multi-agent and lightweight open-weight LLMs can match deterministic annotation of transcriptomic data.

ranked.headline: Physics-constrained learning targets biomolecular kinetics and ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study pair learned models with MD data and physics constraints to access kinetics and ensemble-level behavior.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict drug synergy, binding energetics, pockets, and toxicity
ranked.summary: Uncertainty-aware and graph-based networks now predict synergy, mutational energetics, and liver injury from structural and omics data.

ranked.headline: Neural genomic models gain interpretability and are tested against controls
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend deep sequence models to multimodal, cross-species, and large-scale regulatory datasets while testing added interpretability.

ranked.headline: Graph models fuse molecular structure and biological context for drug-target prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair graph encoders with knowledge graphs, sequence embeddings, and retrosynthetic priors for property and interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer tissue domains and niches from spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend spatial transcriptomics analysis with topological, set-based, and neighborhood-aware models for high-resolution platforms.

ranked.headline: Targeted marker, genome and assembly selection across microbial and eukaryotic datasets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce data-specific tools for selecting markers, genomes and assemblies from large public and metagenomic resources.

ranked.headline: Label-light training strategies reduce annotation demands in biomedical segmentation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints replace dense manual annotation with self-supervision, foundation models, and patch selection across histology and 3D tumour segmentation.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies link genome structure to trait and lineage evolution
ranked.summary: New chromosome-level and long-read references for tunicates, Nicotiana, Avena fatua and sugar beet enable comparative and population-level genome analyses.

ranked.headline: Learned models segment and filter biological images directly from raw or 2D data
ranked.summary: Self-supervised, foundation-model, and training-free tools now operate on raw cryo-ET, cryoEM, microscopy, and phase-imaging data without hand-built pipelines.

ranked.headline: Chromatin accessibility and 3D contacts resolved across cell types and disease
ranked.summary: Single-cell and nucleus multi-omics now link chromatin accessibility and genome architecture to disease-associated regulatory variation.

ranked.headline: Language model embeddings with domain layers predict variant and molecular function
ranked.summary: Pretrained DNA, protein, and sentence embeddings are being paired with task-specific models for variant and RNA prediction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking docking and simulation pipelines against PROTAC and lncRNA targets
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test physics-based and machine-learning docking on PROTAC ternary complexes, alongside a structure-based pipeline for MALAT1 lncRNA ligands.

ranked.headline: Representation learning fuses omics with imaging, histology, and clinical records
ranked.summary: Multimodal deep models now integrate spatial transcriptomics, multiomics, imaging, and clinical data, with cross-modal alignment built into the architecture.

ranked.headline: Local rules set emergent collective dynamics in condensates, epithelia and cell assemblies
ranked.summary: Recent models tie local feedback, crosslinking, and adhesion rules to collective outcomes across condensates, epithelia, and cell self-assembly.

ranked.headline: Explicit constraints guide dynamical model fitting and inference in biological systems
ranked.summary: Recent work couples parameter estimation, model reduction, and interaction inference with explicit structural constraints on dynamical models.

ranked.headline: Waning immunity and reinfection modeled via age-structured PDEs and within-host kinetics
ranked.summary: Dual-age immunity models and within-host extensions for SARS-CoV-2 now appear together, linking reinfection dynamics to vaccination timing.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map allosteric routes linking local structural elements to distal sites
ranked.summary: Recent simulations resolve how lipid, partner, and ligand binding propagate conformational changes to distal functional sites.

ranked.headline: In silico and model-free tools are being validated for RNA sequencing analysis
ranked.summary: Simulation frameworks and reference-based validation are now used to test computational RNA sequencing methods, from modification mapping to probe design.

ranked.headline: Long-read evidence is being used to flag misassemblies and correct phasing errors
ranked.summary: Long-read methods now target misassembly detection, phasing switch errors, and near-complete human assembly benchmarking at reduced coverage.

ranked.headline: Software turns long-read and haplotype data into alleles and mutation effects
ranked.summary: Long-read records now yield alleles and chromatin states directly, while WGS of 347,630 UK Biobank individuals recovers about 88% of pedigree heritability.

ranked.headline: Topological tests and invariants are being used to compare higher-order structure
ranked.summary: Reliable use of inferred dependency structure in omics integration requires comparison and significance testing at the level of whole topological structure.

ranked.headline: Genome mining of human gut bacteria maps defense systems, bacteriocins and prophages
ranked.summary: Large-scale genome collections from human gut bacteria now enable systematic mapping of defense systems, bacteriocins, and strain diversity.

ranked.headline: Complexity and biophysical models link EEG rhythms to sleep and consciousness states
ranked.summary: Quantitative EEG and iEEG readouts of brain state are now paired with mechanistic and adaptive models across sleep, consciousness, and Fragile X.

ranked.headline: Computational tools map ribozyme targets, 3'UTR isoforms, and intronic polyadenylation
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 work applies RNA-seq and secondary-structure prediction to resolve RNA target sites and alternative processing events.

ranked.headline: Emergent self-inhibition and survival constraints shape stable states in complex systems
ranked.summary: Three November 2025 preprints model stability, survival outcomes, and collective agency across ecological, cellular, and multi-agent systems.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve antibody CDR flexibility and spike allosteric rewiring
ranked.summary: Large-scale MD now reaches antibody and TCR loop ensembles, variant spike allostery, and memory-bounded trajectory clustering.

ranked.headline: Canalization makes attractors less stable than their basins in regulatory networks
ranked.summary: Preprints now formalize attractor coherence and feedback design rules for biomolecular circuits, alongside in silico modeling of hepatic lineage induction.

ranked.headline: Regulatory network interactions set cell state plasticity in cancer models
ranked.summary: Models calibrated to single-cell and signaling data now resolve hybrid and population-specific cancer cell states.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes link deletions and recombination suppression to animal evolution
ranked.summary: Late-2025 studies across 154 animal genomes, 18 gibbon species, and 94 mammals resolve genomic changes underlying evolutionary outcomes.
